item.p: The fn: namespace's schema (F&O 4.0, appendix D): its three documents (D.1 analyze-string, D.2 json-to-xml, D.3 csv-to-xml) are known to the schema assembly as xml.xsd is: an import of the namespace the resolver does not deliver (xs:import, XQuery's import schema, xsl:import-schema, the QT4 driver's file-less <schema>) reads them. The processor compiles them once and keeps them (sxml_processor_get_function_namespace_schema). sxml_schema_scope_validate_by_function_namespace validates against an in-scope schema of the namespace first (so that schema-element() matches), else the processor's. fn:json-to-xml validate=true returns the validated tree (duplicates reject by default, retain is FOJS0005); fn:analyze-string returns its typed result (6.3.4 recommends it). later put the processor's schemas behind an optional feature.
Lax validation with no in-scope schema validates against the built-in components (XSD 1.1 Part 1, 3.3.4.6), not FODC0014.

fn:element-to-map's schema-based conversion (14.6.6, 14.6.9): typed elements without a plan entry get the layout their type gives (sxml_schema_scope_describe_content reads attribute uses, wildcards and the particle's element terms with an explicit stack); content is the typed value, an array for list types, cast to the selected type; nilled elements get the layouts' nilled mappings.
fn:deep-equal: type-variety and typed-values (simple content by typed values; type-variety false lets children decide).
fn:doc-available applies fn:doc's options; failures of loading or validating are false, errors in the options are raised.
fn:schema-type finds in-scope schema types; the record gives a complex type's content variety and simple-content-type.
Signatures: fn:parse-xml, fn:json-to-xml, fn:csv-to-xml, fn:jtree and fn:in-scope-namespaces declare the result types F&O 4.0 gives.

The record model (XPath 4.0, 3.2.10.1; PR 2566, PR 2934): a map that is not a record matches no record type, record(*) only records, a structural record type needs as many entries as fields. "A but with B" lowers to the internal row sxml_but_with_function (src/function_library_map.c), which coerces the merged map to A's record type, so chains keep the record. A record called with a key that names no field is XPTY0004 (XDM 4.0, 8.3.2).
XPath 4.0 namespace declarations (A.1): XQST0033 and XQST0070 as XQuery's prolog (5.13); duplicate parameter names are XQST0039.

Measured (release, full runs, baseline at 7f29dc2): this packet's cases XP40 +38 and XQ40 +86 passed, 15 wrong codes made right; 2 lost in each, both honest: fn-doc-available-40-051 now raises FODC0013 for xinclude as fn:doc does, -065 asks for use-xsi-schema-location. XT40 json-to-xml 53 to 60, import-schema 207 to 209.
Lookups (4.15.3.1): a record's key must name a field (XPTY0004); array keys are coerced to xs:integer, so ?1.0 selects (PR 2134). With them XP40 +56 and XQ40 +98 of this packet's cases in all.

Not done (for later sweeps): { E } over JNodes (MapConstructor-500..) in src/evaluator.c. The item axis's JNode parent (, src/xpath_lower.c); a declared function's $a := . found by fn:function-lookup needs the IR to know a shorter arity's default functions (fn-function-lookup-902). XUDY0038 (e) and is-id under construction strip (f) have no QT4 case. The wrong-error passes left (g): 23 per spec are EXPath Binary's 4.0 types (, kept). Also open: fn:xsd-validator's schema, schema-location and target-namespace options (7 cases, FODC0009; the driver serves sources, not schema documents, at those URIs), fn:element-to-map-plan's records, the adaptive method's names for derived types (the suite contradicts itself: Serialization-adaptive-37a against -41/-42), and the NamedRecordTypeDecl module cases (recordTypeDecl/ against the suite's RecordTypeDecl/).
